sections.text:
# Hickory Grove Christian School — Student Clubs (Deep Research)

- **School:** Hickory Grove Christian School, Charlotte, NC (TK–12, est. 1995; a ministry of
 Hickory Grove Baptist Church / HGBC).
 aggregator — PrivateSchoolReview** (S1), which is the only source that enumerates clubs
 by name. The school's own site (hgchristian.org) has **no clubs/activities page**; its
 Academics (S2) and Arts (S3) pages were fetched and corroborate *specific* items but do
 NOT publish a club-by-club list. Wikipedia (S4), Niche (S6, 403-blocked), the church
 ministry page (S7), and the Fall-2024 HS Profile PDF (S8, downloaded + `pdftotext -layout`
 — it is a transcript/grading document with no club or honor-society list) were checked for
 cross-confirmation. See the **single-source flag** below.

corroborates *some* items individually (marked ✓ below); the rest are aggregator-only and
should be flagged as single-source at ingest.

sections.text:
- **The 27-org roster is SINGLE-SOURCE (PrivateSchoolReview, S1).** The school publishes no
 clubs page, and no second source enumerates these clubs. The catalog **should be flagged
 as single-source** when ingested.
- Individually corroborated by the school site: **Discipleship, Choir, Drama, Jazz Band,
 mission trips (DR/Ecuador/Haiti/Kenya), HGBC Food Pantry partnership**, and the yearbook
 **Exodus**. All other named clubs rest on S1 alone.
- Some S1 roster items are national programs (HOSA, Chick-fil-A Leadership Academy, the five
 honor societies) whose national existence is verifiable but whose **active HGCS chapter is
 not independently confirmed**.
- **NOT PUBLISHED anywhere found:** current-year (2025-26) active roster, advisor names,
 membership sizes, honor-society GPA thresholds / induction dates, and any student-life or
 activities landing page on hgchristian.org.
